subject: GUARD_PPM constant value
rationale: All implementations and test vectors use 5000. 250 ppm is too tight for cheap LoRa oscillators (32 kHz RC). May tighten in future hardware revisions with TCXO-grade references.

subject: DENSITY_HIGH threshold for SF upshift, CH0 fallback, and duty-cycle tier
rationale: 25% margin above default 8 slots. Prevents premature SF upshift in moderate-density deployments. All implementations, vectors, and 02-physical-link.md already use >10. Spec 02a had a stale >8.

subject: SCHC Rule 0x08 for TDMA_BEACON
decision: amend-spec: beacon uses fixed-format uncompressed header, not SCHC
rationale: TDMA beacon is not an IPv6/UDP packet. SCHC would save zero bytes on variable fields (epoch, SFN, timestamp). No implementation ever built Rule 0x08. Spec amended to describe the uncompressed format all three implementations use.

subject: Rule 255 RX decode: byte-preserving vs UDP source validation
decision: byte-preserving: decode accepts any well-framed packet with valid checksum regardless of endpoint addresses. Address validation is TX-only.
rationale: SCHC decompressor reconstructs packets, not enforces policy. TX-side validation already exists in _validate_rule255_emission_endpoints. Receiver should preserve bytes for forensics/debugging.

subject: IPv6 option type for DTN S-flag HBH option
decision: Type=0x03 carries both S-flag (flags byte) and absolute expiry (4 bytes) in a single 5-byte option. Zero extra bytes.
rationale: Presence of 0x03 option IS the store-and-forward indication. No separate flags option needed. Already documented in spec 05-routing.md lines 967-981.

subject: Solicited unicast-DIO receive contract (DIS -> unicast DIO admission)
decision: option-A: multicast-only DIO delivery. send_dio() always targets ff02::1a regardless of caller destination. RFC 6550 8.3 unicast-response SHOULD is superseded by the profile contract (R-09-005).
rationale: The admission gate (R-09-005) only admits canonical multicast DIOs. Unicast DIOs are inadmissible at wire_is_for_local. Option A is already implemented in transmit.rs and matches Python parity. Option B (solicitation ledger) deferred as future enhancement.

subject: Trickle Imax: spec 09 14.1 amended from 17 min (1020 s) to 17.07 min (1024 s)
decision: Amend the spec table to Imax = 17.07 minutes (1024 s), matching Imin 4 s × 2^8 doublings. All three implementations (Rust, C, Python) and the packets-timing.json trickle_constants vector already use 1024 s. Changing the stacks to 1020 s would break trickle_constants and require coordinated changes across all three stacks.
rationale: Imin=4 s and doublings=8 produce Imax = 1024 s exactly (a power-of-two result from the doubling mechanism). A 1020 s Imax would require a non-doubling formula or a clamped final interval, introducing unnecessary complexity. The 4-second delta (0.4%) is immaterial to steady-state overhead. Spec 2a.8 and the constants table (2a.10.6) follow the same principle of aligning spec text to implementation-reachable values.

subject: oscore-fork 0.1.3: canonical ContextId location
decision: types.rs::ContextId is canonical; re-export from lib.rs; delete the lib.rs duplicate. Migrate internals to use types::ContextId.
rationale: Two ContextId types (types.rs:86 and lib.rs:205) cause E0053 in downstream SenderStateStore impls. types.rs is where traits live, so it should own the type.

subject: SF upgrade hysteresis (upgrade_count threshold) in adaptive_sf_select step 4
decision: Add hysteresis to spec. Step 4 upgrade requires upgrade_count >= LICHEN_UPGRADE_COUNT_THRESHOLD consecutive qualifying cycles before SF decreases. Rust rf_health.rs must match.
rationale: Without hysteresis, nodes on borderline SNR flap between SF values every cycle. Anti-flapping is standard practice. C implementation already has this; spec pseudocode was incomplete.

subject: CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_VALIDATE and thread-analyzer scope
decision: Debug-only. Create a debug overlay (e.g. debug.conf) enabling these. Production app prj.confs (gateway/puck/bridge) are conformant as-is. The spec qualifiers '(debug builds)' and '(CI and debug builds)' scope the MUSTs.
rationale: Heap validation and thread-analyzer add runtime overhead inappropriate for production LoRa nodes. The spec qualifiers were intentional scoping, not parenthetical suggestions.

subject: DAO Target flags: 8.6 reject-nonzero vs 8.7.1 ignore-reserved contradiction
decision: Keep reject. Amend 8.7.1 to remove the ignore-reserved-flags clause for Target flags. 8.6 reject-nonzero wins.
rationale: Reject is the safer posture — unknown flags could change DAO semantics. All three implementations reject, 52 test vectors pin it. Silently ignoring unknown flags risks subtle routing bugs. Senders MUST zero flags, so no conformant traffic is affected.

subject: Spec 15.2 key-storage MUST: secure element / RDP vs plain-flash reality
decision: Amend spec 15.2: 'stored in flash; never transmitted; secure element preferred where hardware provides it'. Drop the SE/RDP MUST.
rationale: Project threat model (AGENTS.md) explicitly excludes physical/cold-boot attackers — the only adversary SE/RDP defends against. All three stacks use plain flash with integrity. Mirrors GUARD_PPM align-spec-to-reality precedent.
